laws.rule: Under the Toyama Prefecture Mountain Climbing Notification Ordinance, anyone entering the danger zones around Tsurugi-dake between 1 December and 15 May must lodge a climbing notification at least 20 days before (online through Compass or Toyama e-application) and carry the receipt while climbing. From 1 December to 15 April the prefecture asks climbers to cancel or change plans for the special danger zones, and asks solo climbers to cancel.
